description: A typed feature from the KP vocabulary extracted from evidence (by code or by validated LLM output).

agreement.description: Second-opinion agreement label (M5O): corroborated when both vision models named the concept, single_source when only one did, disputed on conflicting anomaly types for one region.

extractor.description: Component that produced this, e.g. 'physics.trim_rpm_split' or 'spark:components_v1'.

sources.description: Vision models behind this observation: 'spark' (Muse Spark 1.3) and/or 'spark_open' (Muse Spark Open via Baseten).
